annotation_provenance.author: Codex
annotation_provenance.method: Direct visual review in the Codex conversation
annotation_provenance.temporal_context: Chronologically displayed selected head frames, reviewed as offline sequences
annotation_provenance.task_instruction: Clean up the table: put drinks on the shelf, fruit and vegetables in the light blue tray, and toys in the white tray.
annotation_provenance.granularity: One proposed next object-level subtask per selected frame
annotation_provenance.completion_policy: When visible sorting appears complete, give a verification instruction
limitations: Wrist images are linked for review but were not used to assign these instructions.
Contact and release can be occluded. Review transitions near object changes.
Source episode task_instruction values are numeric labels (11 or 1), without a supplied mapping. Configured planner task rules were used.
The Nov 11 recordings place fruit in white and the rabbit in blue, conflicting with the configured task. Instructions retain the configured destinations.

method: For each selected frame, sample up to 8 selected frames uniformly from the start of its contiguous instruction segment through the current frame. Return the current frame score. Each time step is a horizontal three-camera composite; context IDs and instructions match the saved head-only run exactly.
resize: Each view RGB 427x240, aspect ratio preserved; concatenate to 1281x240; then the unchanged Qwen processor
